opinions.text: Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari to the District Court of Appeal of California, Second Appellate District, granted. Review is limited to tlie question of whether evidence was admitted which had been obtained by an unlawful search and seizure. Case transferred to the appellate docket.
